summary: Mined 18 files (~11.8K lines) of the dowiz/kernel math/spectral/tensor/eigen core. Highest-value REUSE patterns for the n(0)+geometry+glyph rewrite: (1) trig.rs Phase/Xyz unit-circle geometry is the direct substrate for 'geometry over algebra'; (2) mat.rs/Matrix32x32/CSR contiguous flat-buffer layouts give O(1) index access; (3) simd.rs SoA batch-lane with bit-identity + runtime feature-detect + scalar fallback is the SIMD/geometry rendering template; (4) DriftClass::wire_code + drift_band is the only if-else ladder worth converting to a branchless LUT; (5) eigen.rs ascii() ▬/▲ + bar.repeat is the existing glyph-rendering idiom; (6) delta.rs/wave.rs are the delta-calculus + damped-oscillator primitives. DROP only the O(n⁴) Faddeev-LeVerrier charpoly + Durand-Kerner roots (superseded by Householder; retain solely as parity oracle). Recurring cross-patterns to preserve: sanitize_f64 at boundaries, to_bits parity tests, total_cmp sorting, fixed-seed LCG, arena `_in` twins, type-encoded invariants, and closed enums with const-fn wire codes (no repr(u8) anywhere — the rewrite should keep that convention).
